CRANKSHAFT REAR OIL SEAL
TSB Revision
ENGINE MECHANICAL <3.0L ENGINE>
11C-28
<<B>> PLATE <M/T>/ADAPTER PLATE/FLYWHEEL <M/T>/
DRIVE PLATE <A/T> REMOVAL
Use special tool MB998781 to secure the flywheel or drive 
plate, and remove the bolts.
INSTALLATION SERVICE POINTS
>>A<< CRANKSHAFT REAR OIL SEAL INSTALLATION
1. Apply a small amount of engine oil to the entire 
circumference of the oil seal lip.
2. Use special tool MD998718 to tap in the oil seal as shown in 
the illustration.
>>B<< DRIVE PLATE <A/T>/FLYWHEEL <M/T>/ADAPTER 
PLATE/PLATE <M/T> INSTALLATION
Use special tool MD998781 to hold the flywheel or drive plate 
in the same manner as removal. Then install the bolts.
